title: Reading Drill — Measuring Noise in a Library
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Measuring Noise in a Library
passages.body:
**A** At Bexley Library, staff had several complaints about late-afternoon noise. They borrowed a sound meter and visited the same reading desk at half-hour intervals. They also noted whether the nearby group room was in use.

**B** The readings revealed a brief peak each time the school bus arrived, but a separate disturbance lasted longer. The source of the second event was a door latch that struck its frame whenever someone entered.

**C** The latch was adjusted first. Staff left the group room open because its noise could be reduced by closing a partition, and a new booking form simply asked groups to check that the partition was in place.
